The bound still holds when `a ≤ 0`, because the right-hand side is then `⊤`. In that case `ENNReal.ofReal a = 0`, so `(ENNReal.ofReal a)⁻¹ = 0⁻¹ = ⊤` (`ENNReal.inv_zero`) and `⊤ ^ 8 = ⊤`. That leaves `⊤ * moment8`, which equals `⊤` once `moment8 ≠ 0`.

Why `moment8 ≠ 0`: by definition (line 17 of the file) `moment8 = (eLpNorm id 8 (gaussianReal 0 1)) ^ 8`. By `eLpNorm_eq_zero_iff` (with `8 ≠ 0`), `eLpNorm id 8 (gaussianReal 0 1) = 0` would mean `id =ᵐ 0`, i.e. the set `{x | x ≠ 0}` has measure zero. But `gaussianReal 0 1` has null singletons (`nullSingletonClass_gaussianReal`, since the variance `1 ≠ 0`), so `{0}` also has measure zero. The whole line `ℝ` would then have measure zero, which contradicts `IsProbabilityMeasure (gaussianReal 0 1)`. So the base is nonzero, and its 8th power is nonzero too.

Proof without `ha`: split on `0 < a`. If `0 < a`, keep the existing proof. Otherwise rewrite `ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr (not_lt.mp h)`, then `ENNReal.inv_zero` and `ENNReal.top_pow`, then `ENNReal.top_mul` using the fact that `moment8 ≠ 0`, and close with `le_top`.
